topic.original:
When Will Super-Smart AI Arrive?: A situation that explores the predicted timeline for the arrival of AI as smart as or smarter than humans. This timeline is crucial because it dictates the urgency and type of actions people believe should be taken today regarding AI development and regulation. 
Excludes: "Keeping AI on Our Side," which focuses on how to ensure AI follows human intent, and "What's the Biggest AI Risk," which debates the nature of potential harms.
